hostname ix-q01
!
ip route default 203.0.113.14
ip route 198.51.100.128/25 Tunnel1.0
ip route vrf cust-a 198.51.100.0/25 Tunnel2.0
!
ip access-list sec-sample-any permit ip src any dest any
!
ikev2 authentication psk id ipv4 203.0.113.9 key char dummy-psk-sample-c
ikev2 authentication psk id ipv4 203.0.113.40 key char dummy-psk-sample-c
!
ike proposal ike-prop-sample encryption aes-256 hash sha2-256 group 2048-bit
ike policy ike-sample-any peer any key dummy-psk-sample-vt ike-prop-sample
ike policy ike-sample-name peer-fqdn-ipv4 ix-q09.example.com key DUMMYENCSAMPLENAME key-type secret 1 ike-prop-sample
!
ipsec autokey-proposal ipsec-prop-sample esp-aes-256 esp-sha2-256
ipsec dynamic-map ipsec-sample-any sec-sample-any ike ike-sample-any ipsec-prop-sample
ipsec autokey-map ipsec-sample-name sec-sample-any peer-fqdn-ipv4 ix-q09.example.com ipsec-prop-sample
!
ikev2 profile ikev2-sample-c
  child-proposal enc aes-cbc-256
  child-proposal integrity sha2-256
  local-authentication psk
  sa-proposal dh 2048-bit
  sa-proposal enc aes-cbc-256
  sa-proposal integrity sha2-256
!
interface GigaEthernet0.0
  description sample-wan
  ip address 203.0.113.9/29
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet1.0
  description sample-lan
  ip address 192.0.2.1/25
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet2.0
  description sample-lan-cust-a
  ip vrf forwarding cust-a
  ip address 192.0.2.129/25
  no shutdown
!
interface Tunnel0.0
  tunnel mode ipsec
  ip unnumbered GigaEthernet1.0
  ipsec policy tunnel ipsec-sample-any out
  no shutdown
!
interface Tunnel1.0
  tunnel mode ipsec
  ip unnumbered GigaEthernet1.0
  ipsec policy tunnel ipsec-sample-name out
  no shutdown
!
interface Tunnel2.0
  tunnel mode ipsec-ikev2
  ip vrf forwarding cust-a
  ip unnumbered GigaEthernet2.0
  ikev2 binding ikev2-sample-c
  ikev2 peer 203.0.113.40 authentication psk
  ikev2 source-address GigaEthernet0.0
  no shutdown
